messages:
nina-peopleops: Quick escalation — multiple interviewers seeing back-to-back blocks for the same candidate in their calendar (e.g., 30m interview duplicated at 10:00 and 10:30). Started ~08:22. Looks like availability windows are being split incorrectly in the scheduler.

eli-recruiter: Candidates reported being asked to book two separate slots for the same interview. One candidate even got two Zoom links. Not ideal.

omar-scheduler: I pulled the scheduler logs. When slot length is exactly 30m and interviewer has a 1h availability window, our split logic sometimes emits two adjacent slots instead of a single 30m slot due to an off-by-one in the rounding function. Example: window_start=10:00, window_end=11:00, expected slots=[10:00-10:30,10:30-11:00] but our consumer created two invites for 10:00-10:30 for the same interviewer.

kevin-eng: That explains the duplicates. Which service creates the calendar events? schedule-worker -> calendar-proxy. I'll add a small guard: dedupe by (interviewer_id, slot_start, event_type) before emitting calendar calls. Also fix the slot calculation rounding.

tess-talent: In the meantime we need guidance for interviewers: if you see adjacent duplicate invites, keep the one with the valid Zoom link or the earliest one, and immediately DM People Ops so we can reconcile. Also we should pause auto-invite issuance for affected teams while patching.

amanda-hiringmgr: Some interviewers already accepted the first invite and were auto-joined to Zoom; the second invite caused confusion because they got notified twice. Can we cancel the duplicates without sending new notifications to candidates?

calendar-bot: automation: queued operation cancel-duplicate-invites for job JOB-8801.

omar-scheduler: I can run a targeted cancellation job that finds invites where identical metadata (candidate_id, interviewer_id, slot_start) exist more than once in last 3 hours and cancels all but the earliest. Will exclude invites that have an RSVP "accepted" on a different time. ETA 25m.

eli-recruiter: Please also avoid resending invites to candidates during the cancel job to reduce noise. Candidates are sensitive about multiple links.

kevin-eng: Patch ready: two parts — (1) fix rounding bug in slot-split (PR #4778), (2) add dedupe check before calendar emit (PR #4779). I tested locally and reproduced bug; unit added. Will canary deploy.

nina-peopleops: Action plan: 
- @omar-scheduler run cancel job and share list of affected interviewers & candidates.
- @kevin-eng push canary and confirm behavior for next 30m.
- People Ops to message impacted interviewers with triage steps and a brief FAQ.

calendar-bot: JOB-8801 started: cancelling duplicates (scope: last 6h, dedupe key candidate+interviewer+slot_start).

omar-scheduler: Cancel job completed: 17 duplicate invites cancelled, 4 candidates notified (we sent apologies and clarified correct Zoom link), 3 interviewers had conflicting accepted invites and were contacted by People Ops directly with swap suggestions.

kevin-eng: Canary deployed to 1/3 nodes. Monitoring for duplicated calendar calls metric webhook.calendar.duplicate_count. Current rate dropped to zero in canary. Rolling to full cluster in 15m.

eli-recruiter: Thanks — can you also add a check in the scheduler to log when slot boundaries fall exactly on an hour/half-hour? Might help catch edge cases.

kevin-eng: Good idea; added a debug metric slot_boundary_exact_match to capture those cases. Will include in the postmortem.

tess-talent: I'll update the interviewer training to include a short note: "If you receive adjacent invites with the same candidate and overlapping times, accept the one with the confirmed Zoom link and notify People Ops." We'll include screenshots and an example.

amanda-hiringmgr: Please send me the CSV of affected interviews so I can reach out to candidates I manage.

omar-scheduler: CSV shared in the ticket. Also added a longer-term item: require idempotent invite creation in calendar-proxy and add integration tests that simulate availability windows exactly on boundary conditions.

nina-peopleops: Postmortem actions: fix rounding + dedupe (done), targeted cancel job (done), update training + playbook (in progress), add boundary tests (in backlog). Closing the thread; reopen if duplicates reappear in next 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
